title: Chemical management of phytopathogenic bacteria: emerging compounds, molecular targets and outlook
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00248F, Review Article
Sikai Wu, Zhichao Jin, Peiyi Wang, Runjiang Song, Baoan Song
This review summarizes emerging antibacterials and targets for crop protection. It discusses trends such as AI-driven discovery and immunomodulation, offering novel strategies for controlling phytopathogenic bacteria.
